method.shrinkage_note: Rates are regressed toward the games-weighted league mean with weight K=4. This does NOT improve prediction (rho 0.308 -> 0.301 across 2022-2025, within noise); it reduces small-sample players in the top 20 from 5.0 to 4.0 so the #1 slot is credible.
method.displayed_counts_window: trailing 10 games across seasons, matching TDs
method.anytime_td_prob: P(>=1 TD) = 1 - exp(-xtd_per_game), i.e. Poisson. Provided so mass-market graphics can lead with the probability the Anytime TD market prices instead of a raw expected-TD rate.
method.display: Ready-to-write card strings, so wording lives in the pipeline rather than in each Figma plugin. hero is the anytime-TD probability, stat_1 the hit rate ("6 OF 10"), stat_2 the trend in broadcast language. The hit-rate denominator is the player's actual window, so early-season cards read "3 OF 4" instead of implying missing games. Plugins should write these verbatim and not reformat them.
method.trend: The trailing 10-game window split into the last 3 games vs the earlier ones, on inside-10 targets + carries (the card's 'Inside 10 Opportunities'). direction is up/down/steady at a 15% relative threshold, and is empty when either side has fewer than 2 games.
